第249章 新世界的诞生（第1页）
：第三天，秦川在观澜殿正殿主持了封印内核维护模式的首次全面自检。
变数之页原稿作为对话密钥封存于档案室最高密级区，封印核心玉简已转入维护模式持续监控碎片意识层的重写进度。
虚空夹层第一分馆编目完毕，夜游留下的虚空缝合阵自动维持着分馆的空间稳定。
所有至尊的能量配比已在各自消散前转入维护模式——藏锋的剑体护盾自动维持封印内核物理防护，祝融的熔岩能源从地脉深处持续供给法阵底层热量，夜游的虚空缝合阵将根须层外溢出口永久转为维护通道，赵伯的铜灯仍在自动运行，灯焰中的因果烙印已与图谱内核的残余数据完成对接，开始重新编写中界的基础因果网络——不是预测命运，是记录选择。
秦川将首轮自检报告整理归档，在扉页写下：终焉纪元结束。新世界元年第一天。
三天后，中界的混乱开始自行平息。归墟残余在洛苍山带队清剿下全线溃散，丹霞门分舵主及相关涉案人员被百草谷联合天医宗正式收押。
各地流散的难民开始陆续返回家园。青山村口的老槐树下，孙老六把村口临时草棚拆了，将木料搬回秦川的院子里码好。
“凡人免费诊室”的长期招牌，坐诊的是药童的外派师弟。驼岭镇的钱庄分号收到钱不缺从诸天交易所总号发来的最后一份公文，公文只有一句话：秦川的铜板账户转为无限期维护模式。
秦川将蛛网收到的各地恢复情况简报逐一归档。青山村防疫巡查制度已从应急状态恢复为常态，百草谷的临时医疗站转为长期凡人诊所，沈青黛的新一批烫伤膏配方正式纳入凡人医药手册增订版。
他在手册增订版序言中写道：“此手册非一人之功。青山村李青玄授银针之法，百草谷沈青黛研膏药之方，天医宗柳少微补外伤止血之章。凡用此手册者，当知医道不以修为论高下，不以灵力定深浅。可信者唯人。”写完后他搁下笔，将手册副本交给蛛网渠道分发至各地凡人诊所。
然后他靠在椅背上，看着窗外废墟中透出的微光。新世界没有惊天动地的异象——只是一座又一座的废墟被清理干净，一个又一个的凡人能在井边打水，一个又一个的病人能在诊所里拿到对症的药方。

Chapter 249 The Birth of a New World (Page 1)
: On the third day, Qin Chuan presided over the first comprehensive self-inspection of the seal core maintenance mode in the main hall of Guanlan Hall.
The original manuscript of the Page of Variables is sealed in the highest-security area of ​​the archives as a conversation key, and the jade slip at the core of the seal has been put into maintenance mode to continuously monitor the rewriting progress of the fragmented consciousness layer.
The cataloging of the first branch of the void mezzanine has been completed, and the void stitching array left behind by the night tour automatically maintains the spatial stability of the branch.
All the supreme energy ratios have been transferred to maintenance mode before dissipating - Zang Feng's sword shield automatically maintains the physical protection of the seal core, Zhu Rong's lava energy continues to supply heat to the bottom of the array from the depths of the earth's veins, and the night tour's void suture array permanently converts the root layer overflow outlet into a maintenance channel. Zhao Bo's copper lamp is still running automatically, and the causal imprint in the lamp flame has been connected with the residual data of the core of the map, and the basic causal network of the middle world has begun to be rewritten - not to predict fate, but to record choices.
Qin Chuan filed the first round of self-examination reports and wrote on the title page: The End of the Era is over. The first day of the new world.
Three days later, the chaos in the Middle Realm began to calm down on its own. The remnants of Guixu were completely defeated under the clearing force led by the Luocang Mountain team. The leader of the Danxia Gate Branch and related personnel involved were officially taken into custody by the Baicao Valley and the Tianyi Sect.
Refugees scattered across the country began to return home one after another. Under the old locust tree at the entrance of Qingshan Village, Sun Laoliu dismantled the temporary thatched shed at the entrance of the village and moved the wood back to Qinchuan's yard for stacking.
The long-standing signboard of "Free Clinic for Mortals" is the doctor's expatriate younger brother. The bank branch in Tuoling Town received the last official document sent by Qian Buque from the main account of Zhutian Exchange. The official document had only one sentence: Qinchuan's copper plate account was transferred to indefinite maintenance mode.
Qin Chuan filed the recovery briefings from various places that Spider Web received one by one. The epidemic prevention inspection system in Qingshan Village has returned to normalcy from an emergency state, the temporary medical station in Baicao Valley has been converted into a long-term mortal clinic, and Shen Qingdai's new batch of scald ointment formulas have been officially included in the updated version of the mortal medicine manual.
He wrote in the preface to the updated version of the manual: "This manual is not the work of one person. Li Qingxuan of Qingshan Village taught the method of silver needles, Shen Qingdai of Baicao Valley made plasters, and Liu Shaowei of the Heavenly Medicine Sect wrote about repairing wounds and stopping bleeding. Anyone who uses this manual should know that medical practice does not depend on cultivation, nor does it depend on spiritual power. People are the only ones who can be trusted." After writing, he put down his pen and gave copies of the manual to cobweb channels for distribution to mortal clinics everywhere.
Then he leaned back in his chair and looked out the window at the dim light coming from the ruins. There are no earth-shattering visions in the new world - just ruins one after another being cleared, mortals one after another being able to draw water at the wells, and patients one after another being able to get prescriptions for their symptoms in the clinic.
